newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rubber stable in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 rubber offer prices were generally stable in late trading on Monday amid the absence of buying interest, traders said.

"Buyers wish to sell at 46.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Belawan today for August/September shipment, but traders insist on buying rubber at 45.00 cents/lb. No deals were done today as the result of this situation," said one trader.
Traders said offer prices were quoted at 45.75 cents/lb fob Palembang and Surabaya, 46.00 cents/lb fob Medan and 44.75 cents/lb fob Pontianak and Jambi.
